Class ShamanRitualEventCard

java.lang.Object

it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.events.EventCard
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.events.ShamanRitualEventCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardAction, EventAction
public class ShamanRitualEventCard extends EventCard
Event card that compares shaman stars across players and assigns the configured reward or penalty, taking into account building modifiers.
